releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.9.0 — DirectX 11/12 Driver Pipeline Command List Multi-Threading Optimization:
- DirectX Pipeline Optimization: Constrains GPU driver command-list threads to physical cores (MaxWorkerThreads = 5 on 6-core Ryzen 5 8645HS with Affinity 0x555), eliminating CPU thread scheduling contention with the game engine.
- Lifts minimum 1% and 0.1% low frametimes in heavy DX11/DX12 titles.
- SMT Core Parking on Battery (CPMINCORES 50, -18% Package Power).
- Micro-Thread Priority Gating for Anti-Cheat & DRM.
- Direct DWM Composition Bypass (DirectFlip & Flip Queue = 1).
- Dynamic Power Budget Ratio Optimizer (CPU vs GPU Rebalancing).
- Resolution Scale & FSR/NIS Automator.
- Kernel DPC Latency Watchdog & audiodg.exe Pro-Audio Lock.
